texts.10月5日，LMArena 新增 Claude Opus 5 (High)、Cl: October 5 and LMArena have newly added Claude Opus 5 (High), Claude Sonnet 5 (High), and Gemini 3.7 Flash (High); on the same day, HuggingFace launched google/gemma-4-26B-A4B as a fine-tuning base. The simultaneous releases on three platforms show leading manufacturers accelerating iterations and covering the full spectrum from flagship to lightweight.
texts.9月21日，阿里百炼上线qwen-audio-3.1-realtime-plus: September 21, Alibaba Cloud Model Studio is launched with qwen-audio-3.1-realtime-plus, replacing the 3.0 version, priced at 40 CNY/million tokens for input and 150 CNY/million tokens for output. On the same day, Volcano Ark released the AgentPilot OpenAPI usage guide, focusing on agent integration. This week, model releases occurred on this 1 day only, but the upgrade signals for real-time audio models are clear, showing that vendors are accelerating iteration in the voice interaction track.
texts.9月28日成为本周发布高峰，LMArena单日新增6款模型，包括GPT 6 So: September 28 marked this week's release peak, with LMArena adding 6 new models in a single day, including the GPT 6 Sol (Max), Deepseek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3 series, and Gemini 3.8 Flash. On the same day, MiniMax launched M3.1-Flash-Preview, available only through the Token Plan and Code channels; Artificial Analysis added the MiMo-V2.6-Flash evaluation. Same-day releases across multiple platforms reflect that leading manufacturers are accelerating their iteration pace.
texts.Claude Haiku 5.5 定价改为按 prompt 长度区分，超 10: Claude Haiku 5.5 pricing is changed to differentiate by prompt length; those exceeding 100000 token will incur higher prices.
texts.Claude Opus 5.5 (High)定价$1.28/task，而Fabl: Claude Opus 5.5 (High) is priced at $1.28/task, while Fable 5.1 (Max) rose from $1.71 to $3.66, a gain exceeding 1 times. GPT 6 Sol (Max) is quoted at $0.82, and Deepseek V4.1 Flash is not priced, indicating that both high-end and inclusive approaches coexist. On the same day, Kimi adjusted its cache billing: hit inputs will no longer be charged a write fee again, making the pricing structure more refined.
texts.GPT-6 Astra 定价成为本周高端模型价格锚点，缓存和批量档位同步公布。G: GPT-6 Astra pricing has become this week's price anchor for high-end models, with cache and batch tiers announced alongside it. Gemini 3.8 Flash enters at a low price against $0.75/$3.75, creating a contrast. Google Vertex AI adds the Global tier price ($120/$216) and removes the summary row. SiliconFlow adjusts DeepSeek-V4-Flash time-of-day pricing and the V4-Pro cache-hit price. Cohere's pricing page adds retrieval-optimized and semantic representation models, but removes the $4 and 300 tiers. Frequent price changes reflect rising market sensitivity to costs.
texts.Mistral 宣布完成 30 亿欧元 D 轮融资，投后估值超 210 亿欧元，: Mistral announces the completion of a 3000000000 EUR D-round financing, with a post-investment valuation exceeding 21000000000 EUR, to be used to advance the development of open-source weight AI technology.
texts.博客新增了关于 30 亿欧元 D 轮融资的公告文章，文章总数从 82 篇增加到: The blog has added an announcement article about the 3000000000-euro D funding round; the total number of articles increased from 82 to 83, consistent with updates on the changelog and pricing pages.
texts.变更日志新增了关于 30 亿欧元 D 轮融资的公告文章，文章数量从 82 篇增加: The changelog has added an announcement article about the 3000000000-euro D funding round; the number of articles increased from 82 to 83, which is the only significant change that day.
texts.多条模型描述更新：Claude Fable 5 定位从『widely relea: Multiple model description updates: Claude Fable 5 positioning changed from widely released to open to all customers, Claude Opus 4.7 emphasizes complex reasoning and agent coding, Claude Opus 4.8 emphasizes default 1M context window; also added compliant API feature changes (activity source metadata removal, local session endpoint GA, restored billing for specific denials), reflecting adjustments to model positioning and compliance features.
texts.多个模型价格变动：Claude Fable 5.1 (Max) 涨至 $4.66: Price changes for multiple models: Claude Fable 5.1 (Max) rose to $4.66/task, Gemini 4 Argon (High) rose to $0.66/task, Deepseek V4.1 Flash rose to $0.10/task, and Claude Opus 5.5 (High) was slightly adjusted to $1.58/task. Entries such as GLM 5.3 (Max), MiMo V2.6 Flash/Pro, and Hy4 preview were added, and the old entries related to Claude Opus 5 were removed.
texts.定价页更新 token 估算：Claude 4.7 及更新模型和 Claude: The pricing page was updated on token: the token count for Claude 4.7, the updated models, and Claude Mythos Preview was adjusted from 325 to 244 (old model), token costs for text_editor_20250728 were added, and the entry for the old tool text_editor_20250429 was removed, reflecting the model version update.
texts.定价页面新增了公司完成 30 亿欧元融资的公告，同时删除了关于区域内推理、开放模: The pricing page has added an announcement that the company completed 3000000000 euros in financing, while removing old descriptions of in-region inference, open models, and new European infrastructure, indicating that the page content has shifted from product introduction to the company's major news.
texts.新增 Architectural visualization with Astr: New Architectural visualization with Astra and Building games with Astra 2 application cases were added, while older entries such as Codex as a platform and Scaling cyber defenders were removed, reflecting that OpenAI is updating its model application showcase page to highlight Astra's deployment scenarios.
texts.新增 qwen3.8-omni-flash 的定价（中国内地、全球、国际三档），: Added pricing for qwen3.8-omni-flash (three tiers: mainland China, global, international), added pricing rows for qwen3-asr-flash, qwen3.6-flash, and qwen3.8-livetranslate-flash-realtime, and removed pricing for multiple U.S. regions (e.g., deepseek-v4-flash-us, glm-5.2-us, etc.), possibly reflecting regional service adjustments.
texts.新增了 ChatGPT mobile app、Connect voice to: ChatGPT mobile app, Connect voice to Decisions, and Decisions API 3 entries have been added, while 2 alias descriptions about network security models and the Daybreak Blue/Red model have been removed, indicating OpenAI is adjusting the model list by removing old security model aliases and adding model entries related to Decisions API.
texts.新增了 Grok 4.7 (Low) 与 JT-4.1 Flash 236B A: Added Grok 4.7 (Low) and JT-4.1 Flash 236B A21B (Reasoning) evaluation items, and removed the old MiMo-V2.6-Flash and JT-4.1 Flash entries, updating the model evaluation list. Also added 'Korean AI Lab Upstage releases Solar Mini 4' and 'New language model evaluation' 2 news items.
texts.新增了Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk)及其上手体验文章，新增: New Mistral Large 4 (with articles on hands-on experience with Le Chonk), newly added models GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6.1 Sol, while task prices for some models have been adjusted (Claude Opus 5.5 increased from $1.58 to $1.67, Deepseek V4.1 Flash increased from $0.12 to $0.13), and the GPT-5.6 series has been removed, reflecting updates to the benchmark models).
texts.新增多款模型（Claude Opus 5、Sonnet 5、Gemini 3.7: Added several new models (Claude Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Gemini 3.7 Flash, GPT 6.1 Sol, etc.), adjusted GPT 6 Luna pricing, upgraded Claude Fable 5 to 5.1 with a price adjustment, and removed Deepseek V4.1 Flash and Qwen 3.8 27B, reflecting changes in the model lineup and pricing.
texts.本周 OpenAI 于 9 月 4 日发布 GPT-6 Astra，定价输入 $: This week, OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra on September 4, priced at $10/MTok for input and $50/MTok for output, targeting enterprise Trusted Access Program. Google Vertex AI launched on Gemini 3.8 Flash the same day, featuring long-form coding and autonomous agents, with introductory pricing of $0.75/$3.75 per million tokens. September 5 Google Gemini API launched the Lyria 3.5 official release, replacing 2 preview versions. SiliconFlow is available on zai-org/GLM-5.3. Multiple platforms launching updates on the same day shows competition is focusing on iteration of flagship models.
texts.本周阿里百炼上架 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，并公布闲时定价 1.0: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio launched DeepSeek V4.1 Flash this week and announced off-peak pricing CNY 1.094; xAI simultaneously raised the starting price of Agent to $0.08/min. Artificial Analysis added a K2 Horizon 0.9B/3.7B/7B/MoVA 36B A4B review, while LMArena added multiple claude-fable-5.1-max scores for Elo (1498/1513/1710). Multi-platform updates on the same day show the pace of new model releases is accelerating.
texts.榜单出现多款新模型（Claude Opus 5.5、GPT 6 Sol、GPT: The leaderboard shows several new models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6 Sol, GPT 5.6 Luna, Deepseek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3 series, Gemini 3.8 Flash), while the Claude series versions are updated (Fable 5→5.1, Opus 4.8→5, Opus 5 from High to Max), with prices rising and falling, reflecting overall model iteration and pricing changes.
texts.榜单更新：Claude Opus 5.5 (High) 取代 Claude Op: List update: Claude Opus 5.5 (High) replaces Claude Opus 5 (High), price slightly adjusted from $1.73 to $1.74; added models including GPT 6.1 Sol, MiMo V2.6 Pro and Muse Spark 1.3, and removed Claude Fable 5 and Deepseek V4 Flash, reflecting changes in rankings and models.
texts.模型列表发生大规模变动：新增 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731、De: The model list has undergone major changes: new models such as DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 and ERNIE 5.1 have been added, while DeepSeek-V4-Flash, ERNIE-X1.1, ERNIE-X1.1-Preview, GLM-5 and Kimi-K2.6 have been marked as being phased out, reflecting the platform's rapid iteration of its model lineup.
texts.模型列表发生重大更新：新增Claude Haiku 5.5，包含完整的上下文窗口: A major update to the model list: Claude Haiku 5.5 added, including full context window, pricing, retirement date, and other specifications; Claude Haiku 4.5 and its related configurations removed; and Haiku ID updated from 4.5 to 5.5 on all platforms (Bedrock, API, AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry), indicating that the Haiku series has officially been succeeded.
texts.模型列表新增 deepseek-v4-pro-0813、deepseek-v4-: The model list adds deepseek-v4-pro-0813, deepseek-v4-flash-0731, kimi/kimi-k3, etc., while removing the older deepseek-v4-pro and kimi/kimi-k3, possibly for a version update; embedding and reranking models were also replaced as a whole, adding the qwen3.7 series and removing text-embedding-v4 and qwen3-rerank.
texts.模型列表更新日期从 9月23日 变为 9月24日，新增 antigravity-: The model list update date changed from September 23 to September 24, adding antigravity-preview-09-2026 and 3 TTS model descriptions (Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS, Flash-Lite TTS, Legacy TTS), deleting antigravity-preview-05-2026 and its description, indicating a generation change of the TTS model.
texts.模型列表页面结构发生重大变化，新增了 Chat Completions (Leg: The model list page structure has undergone major changes, adding sections such as Chat Completions (Legacy), Generated Media, and Image Understanding, announcing model retirement dates, and removing old sections such as Completions (Legacy) and Enterprise Deployments, indicating that the API documentation is undergoing a comprehensive restructuring.
texts.硅基流动宣布 Nex-N2-Pro、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B、Mini: SiliconFlow announced that Nex-N2-Pro, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, MiniMax-M2.5 and other models will be removed from September 11. xAI announced that the Imagine Image Quality feature November 2 will be retired. OpenAI removed old entries such as Codex as a platform, and Cohere deleted the price information for $4 and 300. The platform is centrally clearing preview versions and old features to free up resources for new products, while also reminding users to pay attention to the model lifecycle.
texts.阿里百炼移除 deepseek-v4-flash-0731，替换为 deepse: Remove Alibaba Cloud Model Studio deepseek-v4-flash-0731 and replace with deepseek-v4.1-flash; remove Artificial Analysis Gemini 3.8 Flash evaluation items; replace LMArena claude-fable-5 and opus-4-6 old scores; delete the old blog Cohere `Automating fork maintenance with AI agents`. Platforms should synchronously clean up old resources to make room for new content.
texts.多个模型价格下调（Claude Opus 5.5、Deepseek V4.1 F: Prices for multiple models have been reduced (Claude Opus 5.5, Deepseek V4.1 Flash, Muse Spark 1.3), GPT 6.1 Sol (Max) has been added and GPT 6 Astra (Max) and GPT 5.6 Terra (xHigh) removed, while Gemini 3.8 Flash has been renamed to Gemini 3.7 Flash, reflecting routine adjustments to listed models and pricing as total session counts update.
texts.榜单中新增了 Claude Opus 5.5 系列（High 和 Max 档）以: The list now includes the Claude Opus 5.5 series (High and Max tiers) and new pricing for GPT 6.1 Sol (Max), and has removed the Gemini 3.7 Flash (High) entry, while adjusting prices for several models (e.g., increases for Deepseek V4.1 Flash and MiMo V2.6 Pro), reflecting real-time changes in the model lineup and pricing.
texts.10月12日LMArena新增Claude Opus 5.5 (High)与GP: October 12LMArena adds Claude Opus 5.5 (High) and GPT 6.1 Sol (Max), priced at $1.86/task and $0.62/task respectively. On the same day, SiliconFlow launched the high-speed version GLM-5.3-Flash, and HuggingFace added nvidia/LocateAnything-3B and a quantitative version. Three platforms rolled out new offerings on the same day, indicating leading vendors are accelerating iteration.
texts.阿里百炼删除Qwen3-Omni-Captioner、qwen3-14b、dee: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio removes pricing rows for Qwen3-Omni-Captioner, qwen3-14b, deepseek-v4-flash, etc., while specifying that free quotas for Qwen3.5-Omni and Qwen3-Omni are only available in North China 2 (Beijing). The xAI documentation link changed from SpaceXAI Docs to SpaceXSI Docs, possibly a brand renaming. With cleanup and restrictions happening at the same time, the platform is scaling back free resources.
